mentions.title: King Bearings? - Don Terrill's Speed-Talk
mentions.snippet: Builders report King main bearings out of spec on 'free spread', with a 2024 set confirmed out of spec by King's own technical line and a 2025 set showing the same issue, suggesting the problem spans production runs. Next production reportedly not until January 2027.
mentions.replyNote: Thread is readable and still open; no official King representative has responded and it is not locked or marked resolved.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective | BMW M5 Forum and M6 Forums
mentions.snippet: Poster reports King STDX thrust bearings measuring over 1mm too narrow to fit BMW S85 and S65 blocks, and concludes King main bearings cannot be trusted for these engines if something this fundamental is wrong.
mentions.replyNote: Still 307-redirects to the tollbit.m5board.com mirror instead of returning thread content.
